newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Elan says net income $28.5mln to end Sept.
newsitem.headline: Elan says net income $28.5mln to end Sept.

text.p: Elan Corporation Plc said on Tuesday that its net income for the three months to end September was $28.5 million before a one-time charge.
A one-time charge of $484.8 million arose from the acquisition of Athena Neurosciences and largely represents the been written off in the income statement, Elan said in a results statement.

The pharmaceutical group, which reported unchanged earnings per share of $0.29, said the one-time charge included a provision of $30 million for the integration, rationalisation and repositioning of certain Elan businesses including the disposal of non-strategic interests.

"At the same time, a process of review and re-focusing of the drug delivery business is in progress to maximise the opportunities for our drug delivery technologies and to ensure that our manufacturing facilities operate at maximum efficiency," Geaney said.

Elan reported an increase of 70 percent in total revenues for the quarter to $83.3 million compared to the same quarter in 1995 but the underlying revenue growth rate, excluding the revenue contribution from Athena, was 36 percent, it said.
Revenue from product sales rose 78 percent for the quarter, largely reflecting the launch of the drug Naprelan and the inclusion of Athena revenues for the first time, it said.
